verdict.rationale: Inside the product, Query Assistant uses AI to turn natural-language questions into Honeycomb queries [honeycomb-docs-4], which helps users explore their data but is not AI-generated insight. The richer AI capabilities, such as diagnosing latency or error spikes and suggesting optimizations, run in external AI agents connected through the MCP server, not in Honeycomb's own UI [honeycomb-docs-9][honeycomb-docs-10]. Missing for 10: in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the data (beyond generating queries), documentation of any native AI analysis, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
